en.html:
Standing beside a river, not particularly wide but apparently deep, I established the facts.

A modest but useful wooden bridge had once crossed here. Now useless frameworks remained on either bank.
Last night, stepping into that argument... details escaped me, but I had repeatedly heard the word bridge. Somebody had broken it, or something.

It must be this one. This bridge seemed to have caused their openly hostile quarrel.

ja.html:
幅は然程でもないが、深さがありそうな川のほとり。
　そこに立って、事実を確認する。

　粗末ながら有用な木橋が、嘗てここに架かっていた
のだろう。
　今は何の役にも立たない木組が両岸に残るばかりだ
が。

　昨晩、言い合いの中に分け入った時……詳細は思い
出せないが、確かに橋という単語を何度も聴いた。
　橋を壊したとか、どうとか。

　これの事に違いない。
　この橋が原因で、昨夜の人々は敵意も露わに争って
いた様子だった。

en.html:
One man had a powerful voice. Housewives washing clothes, a young man newly out of bed: neighbors began looking over.

Little disapproval in those looks. Most agreed.
The sudden population increase had worsened living conditions; the established residents were deeply dissatisfied. Was that it?

With resources to spare, public authorities might take appropriate measures. Not something to hope for now.
A difficult problem.

ja.html:
男性の一方は、声がかなり大きい。
　洗濯中の主婦や、置き抜けの青年など、周辺の住民
から視線を集めつつあった。

　しかしその中に、非難の色は薄い。
　賛同の意思を寄せるものが大半だった。

　人口の急増で生活環境が悪化したため、旧来の住民
はみな強い不満を抱いている……そういう事か。
　公的機関に余力があれば適切な措置も期待できるが、
今は望むべくもない。

　これは中々、厄介な問題のようだ。

en.html:
Kageaki"About this bridge..."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"Ah. Their fault too."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"We used it to get into town. Now everyone working on the other side has to go downstream to another bridge."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"A ridiculous detour, bhai."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"Stupid business..."
Kageaki"The refugees destroyed it?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"Doesn't look like wind or flood, does it?"
Kageaki"Indeed. But what evidence points to the refugees?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"Evidence... None. But who else?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"They live across the river. Fed up with us coming to complain, so they broke the bridge. Must be."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"Not saying they're all stupid enough to think no bridge means no complaints. But it was old. One idiot could bring it down."
Kageaki"..."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"Do something, officer."
Kageaki"Yes. I should like to establish the facts and take appropriate action."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"Appropriate action. Can't depend on an official's appropriate action."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"Maybe ask the underworld・ fellows after all?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"The ones offering to patrol here?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"More than that. Said they'd discuss clearing the refugees out too."
ｅｔｃ／住民Ｂ"You heard the protection fee. How do we pay that every month?"
ｅｔｃ／住民Ａ"That's the trouble... They know they've got us."
